Bars 116-118 closed higher (2754.31, 2760.51, 2775.61) and stayed above bar 115's close; bar 119 (open 2775.60, high 2776.18, low 2727.22, close 2738.87) is a bear bar closing near its low.
Bars 116-119 overlap in a tight 2718.09-2804.59 band; the window closes at 2738.87, which is 111.13 below the 2850.00 high and 38.87 above the 2700 level.

structures.description: Broad two-sided range covering most of the window: repeated overlapping swings between the 2357.18 window low (bar 1) and the 2700 top tested on bars 103 and 113, including the failed spike to 2680.00 on bar 56 and the return to the 2500 area on bar 57.

Rising leg off the 2358.62 low (bar 81) with overlapping pullbacks rather than a clean spike: higher lows 2435.71 (bar 92) and 2568.16 (bar 109), higher highs 2643.52 (bar 99) and 2804.59 (bar 118). It stayed inside the 2357.18-2700 range until bars 115-118.

Bull breakout above the 2700 range top on bar 115 (open 2658.81, high 2850.00, close 2723.15), with bars 116-118 closing above the breakout bar's close and holding above 2700. Breakout is about five bars old at the decision time.

Tight four-bar overlap (bars 116-119) between 2718.09 and 2804.59 just below the 2850.00 spike high; a pause at the breakout level that is either an early bull flag or the start of a failed breakout back into the old range.

evidence_for: Bar 115 broke above the 2700 top that had capped bars 0-113 and exceeded both earlier failed spike highs (2680.00 on bar 56, 2700 on bars 103 and 113), making a new window high at 2850.00.

Follow-through differs from the earlier failures: bars 116-118 all closed above bar 115's 2723.15 close, whereas bar 56 was followed immediately by bar 57 (open 2557.34, close 2538.73) giving back the spike.
Multi-leg advance since bar 81 shows higher lows (2435.71 bar 92, 2568.16 bar 109, 2718.09 bar 116) and higher highs (2643.52 bar 99, 2700 bar 103, 2850.00 bar 115), i.e., more than a single leg.
The bars 107-109 pullback ended with a doji at 2568.16 (bar 109) and bar 110 closed on its high 2611.00, a bull reversal bar that began the final advance.
At the decision time no bar has closed back inside the pre-breakout range; price remains above the 2700 breakout level.
evidence_against: Roughly the first 78 of 120 bars (bars 0-77) were two-sided inside 2357.18-2700.00 with heavy overlap, so the trend evidence rests on the last ~38 bars of a window that was mostly a trading range.
Bar 115 closed at only about 34% of its own 191.94 range with a 126.85 upper tail, so it was not a strong close-at-high breakout bar.
Two earlier spikes failed in the same location: bar 56 reached 2680.00 and closed 2555.52, and bar 103 reached 2700 and closed 2638.49, each followed by a slide toward 2500-2570.
Bar 119 (open 2775.60, close 2738.87, low 2727.22) is a bear bar closing near its low and erasing the closes of bars 116-118, leaving the last four bars overlapping in the 2718.09-2804.59 band.
No bar has closed above 2804.59 and the breakout is only about five bars old, so acceptance above the old range top is unproven; volume on bar 115 (8.43M) is below the window's heaviest prints.

An equally plausible reading is that bars 115-119 are a final flag / exhaustion pause at the top of a 20-day range rather than the start of a sustained bull trend; nothing has yet broken down to confirm that alternative.
transition_conditions: Bull confirmation: a close above 2804.59 (bar 118 high) and then above 2850.00 (bar 115 high) would show acceptance of the range breakout and support continuation of the bull trend in spike phase.

Failed breakout: a close back below 2700 would signal rejection of the breakout level, and a close below bar 115's low 2658.06 would confirm a failed range breakout and shift the read toward trading-range/two-sided.
Trend damage: a close below 2568.16 (bar 109 low) would end the higher-low sequence running from bar 92 and move the read toward transition-unclear.

Pause resolution: continued overlapping bars inside 2718.09-2804.59 with no new high would reclassify the current phase as a channel/pause and reduce always-in relevance, while a close above 2804.59 would extend the spike.
A pullback that holds above 2804.59 after a new high above 2850.00 would mark the first higher low of a confirmed bull channel.
